character: A band of rough gunners of mixed ancestries: sunburned humans, a dwarf, a ratfolk. Faces and forearms blackened with powder smoke, eyes narrowed.
wardrobe: Powder-stained shirts, red sashes stuffed with flintlock pistols, a pistol in each hand, powder horns on cords.

full.framing: Group shot, front view. Five gunners in a line on a ship's deck, pistols levelled at the viewer.

portrait.framing: Tight group portrait, square crop, three gunners' faces crowded together filling the frame, pistols raised beside them.

scene.framing: A line of gunners firing flintlock pistols across a gap of open water at another ship, clouds of white powder smoke.
